title: Research report on three ways to read the formula

tellings.quote: So, one of the first pieces of research we got back on it was like a 20page whatever that broke into like the three main ways to interpret it are

plain: A roughly 20-page research report is said to have broken down the three main ways to interpret a certain formula. Bryce Zabel, who worked on it, tells Michels it was "one of the first pieces of research we got back" on the formula, though he does not say who wrote it, and what the three readings were is left vague.
